name: Enterprise Knowledge Landscape and Decision Dependency View
constraints: Knowledge Landscape is a governed profile declaration and Decision Dependency View is a reproducible projection; neither mints subject-matter identity.
Records, concepts, scheme releases, claims, citation acts, decision content and issued expressions retain separate mastership.
Every semantic edge names one owning model and remains read-only outside it; relation, similarity and shared labels never authorize identity merging.
Every dependency edge pins claim version, record version, scheme release, consulted representation and decision release.
Retraction and rebuttal append dated observations and trigger notify-and-recheck traversal without automatically revoking decisions.
Unknown, unsupported, refuted, missing binding, unresolved locator and dangling rationale remain distinct states.
Access restrictions propagate through summaries, closures, counts, co-citation and inference; restricted paraphrase remains disclosure.
Redaction creates a new rendition with its own digest and provenance and never overwrites the source.
holds: Evidence Artifact / Source Work remains identifier-unassigned under EM-KNW-02.
Access scope, citation deduplication, relation direction and timestamp-offset semantics require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review, semantic crosswalks and frozen audit remain pending.
